notes: Actual UMD entrypoints and the OpenVINO NPU provider execute on physical Delta; owned allocation/runtime callback shims supply the memory boundary. No custom kernel driver is installed on Delta.
The exact two supported shader/blend modes are checked in both formats and ordinary/shared component resources. Unsupported shader/state rejection and cleanup remain part of the executable contract.
The UMD returns DXGI_STATUS_NO_REDIRECTION during device creation, but the callback shims do not validate Windows runtime routing. The separate disposable guest test covers that boundary.
